packs.title: Across the Coast and Island
packs.promise: Explore distinct Pattaya places through observation, movement and original creation.

q.t: Three Ways to Display a Craft
q.s: Collect observations from the admitted market.
st: Enter an operating visitor lane and select three visible craft or merchandise displays that traders permit you to observe.
For each, record the object or product, the material you can actually identify, and one way the stall displays it. Leave goods in place.
Compare which display makes its contents easiest to understand and give one visible reason.
Use an admitted viewing area without blocking the tunnel or other visitors.
Find three different visible body forms or movement patterns. Describe each in your own words; species names are optional unless a clear label supplies them.
Compare one feature shared by two observations and one feature that differs.

q.s: Collect three details of ordinary market trade.
st: From a clear customer position, choose three visible details connected with displaying, weighing, containing or keeping goods cool.
Record what each detail does in the trading process. Use only what you actually observe rather than guessing a trader’s methods.
Put the three observations into a simple sequence from display to sale or handling. Do not touch goods or tools.

packs.title: Along the Waterfront and Hill
packs.promise: Explore distinct Pattaya places through observation, movement and original creation.

q.s: Collect visual techniques inside the paid museum.
st: Choose three painted illusions you can observe from ordinary admitted visitor positions.
For each, collect one visible technique: an edge, a shadow, a change of scale or another detail that suggests depth.
Compare how one illusion changes from two permitted viewing positions. Describe the difference without climbing props or copying the artwork.

q.s: Create a response to the north-central shore.
st: Choose a clear public shore position away from boats and the road.
Observe a near line, the curve of the beach and a distant line visible that day.
Create an original three-line sketch or three-sentence written composition that preserves their different distances.

q.s: Create a small design response in the operating market.
st: From an ordinary open market lane, observe the aircraft’s outline without entering it or blocking trade.
Note one contrast between the aircraft shape and the surrounding stalls or street-level space.
Create an original small silhouette sketch or a short written design response expressing that contrast. Make it in a clear permitted spot or afterwards from your observations.
